intro: Hungary has won more Olympic gold medals per person than almost any other country, especially in water polo, swimming and fencing.

chapters.title: Water polo and swimming
text: Hungary is the most successful water polo nation in Olympic history, with nine men's gold medals. Swimmers such as Krisztina Egerszegi, Katinka Hosszú and Kristóf Milák are Olympic champions.

chapters.title: The Golden Team
text: In the 1950s Hungary's 'Golden Team', led by Ferenc Puskás, beat England 6-3 at Wembley, the first time a team from outside Britain and Ireland had beaten England at home. The Hungarian Grand Prix, first held in 1986, was the first Formula One race behind the Iron Curtain.

keyTerms.meaning: A team sport played in a swimming pool, scoring goals with a ball.
